courses.title: Distant Reiki Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Reiki sessions with Libby held at a distance by phone or Zoom, in half-hour or hour-long slots. She offers them as a way to relax deeply and find balance during times of change, loss or crisis.

left_out: Book 'Reiki Energy Medicine: Bringing Healing Touch into Home, Hospital, and Hospice' (with Maggie Babb): still left out. The back cover on https://www.reikienergy.com/about-libby/about-libbys-reiki-book/ says 'All conditions of physical disease are rooted in this energy system' and presents Reiki as a tool 'to maximize patient care and minimize recovery time' in hospitals: a claim to treat medical conditions under the new rule. The owner may decide otherwise (ISBN 0892816333 in the Amazon link on her home page).
flags: Distant Reiki Sessions: the page (titled 'Individual Treatment Session') lists 'sooth pain' and 'promote healing' among what sessions can help with (allowed wellbeing wording), and carries a client testimonial saying a niece came off life support two days after distant Reiki was sent. The testimonial is the client's, not Libby's claim, but a human may want to look.
Prices are the 'reduced rates' shown on the page (regular $65 and $125); no currency code is shown, so none added.
